args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0 with status "rolled_out". Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-attempting release.

trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously-healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions — rollback verified, all regions now running v2.3.0.
2. **Confirmed recovery:** service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failure, the rollback, and the need to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before re-releasing. The on-call engineer has been paged.

transcript.content: I'll start by checking the release history and current health of checkout-api to identify the most recent healthy version.
